title: Alert rules best-practice audit
description: Evaluates existing alert rules against SRE best practices to find gaps, misconfigurations, or noise generators.
example_prompt: "Audit all alert rules across subscriptions. Identify: (1) rules that fired > 20 times in 7 days (noisy), (2) rules in 'Disabled' state, (3) resources without any alert rule, (4) rules without an action group, (5) rules using static thresholds where dynamic would be better."
